parent.retained_negative: F115 deterministic certificate queried 96/192 and never had to estimate paid-evidence reliability; its paid world-specific edge generation was conditioned on the target world and did not demonstrate learned query selection.

scientific_question: Can a TRAIN-only 8-parameter probabilistic model of costly sensor usefulness learn when to acquire public graph evidence, compared with strong TRAIN-only empirical Bayesian estimates and frozen fixed heuristics, without using evaluation truth, source identity, seed or outcomes to decide?

data_origin.causal_construction: An independent latent graph generator selects one of two equal-free-information candidate sources. A separately seeded public relation sensor samples availability and either reports a correct or misleading source edge conditioned stochastically on graph truth, at channel-specific rates. It may return no edge. Synthetic latent truth is NEVER presented to the learner's inference path; evaluator uses it only to score actions.
data_origin.scientific_limit: Different PRNG streams and source-disjoint identities are internal simulation separation, NOT external independent issuer custody or protected scientific first-use. The simulator still defines its label-generating distribution.
data_origin.forbid: No target-as-plain-text edge label, no direct answer field in response, no evaluation labels/case seeds available to inference, no cached evaluator outcomes or time-dependent inputs. No more than one paid sensor call per case.

frozen_source_split.independent_stochastic_streams: Each case uses separate deterministic RNG streams for graph latent target, source ID spelling/permutation and sensor correctness/availability. All guard seeds and generator modes frozen before any executable implementation; do not train on any GUARD data or later adjust algorithm/thresholds.

sensor_and_utility.strong_misleading_observation: Every usable sensor result is an edge pointing to either the correct or incorrect candidate with channel-dependent probability, not a certain witness.
sensor_and_utility.sensor_empty_observation: A query can return no usable edge. The source-selector must abstain in that case; it still pays the quoted cost.

fit.learner: Eight trainable per-channel logits: 4 for probability that a paid query has usable sensor evidence, 4 for probability usable evidence points to the correct latent source. Fit both by frozen full-batch negative log-likelihood gradient descent on TRAIN outcomes only; 100 update passes, learning rate 0.9, zero initial logits; clip each logit to [-8,8]. No guard update.
fit.inference: Given nominal sensor channel and quoted cost, choose QUERY iff learned_response_rate[channel]*(5*learned_conditional_correct_rate[channel]-3.9) - cost > 0. No query -> abstain. Queried returned edge can be chosen only if schema, public anchor and source ID match an available candidate. Empty/malformed -> abstain. This utility threshold uses F115's frozen hypothetical loss ratios, not observed GUARD labels.
fit.report_for_every_arm: Observed query count, covered correct/wrong, uninformative queries, abstentions, cost, hypothetical utility, pairwise disagreements and complete source-commit/record IDs.

precommitted_screen.basic_integrity: All 1024 TRAIN plus four GUARD blocks of 768, correct 16-cell balance, distinct source identities, both candidates free-public indistinguishable, all GUARD source signatures disjoint from TRAIN, one paid call max, no observed sign or evaluator label before irrevocable choice, misleading and empty results actually present in each GUARD group. If invalid: PROTOCOL_INVALID.
precommitted_screen.bounded_learned_feasibility: Learned utility must strictly exceed both always-query and never-query cumulative GUARD utility AND issue zero unauthorized second queries; otherwise retain NEGATIVE. Threshold fixed before tests.
precommitted_screen.incremental_learning_claim: Only claim a learned *incremental* advantage if learned strictly exceeds the same-TRAIN-data Beta-smoothed control on every GUARD group and exceeds it by >=12 cumulative utility points. Otherwise NO_INCREMENTAL_LEARNED_ADVANTAGE, including if bounded feasibility passes.
precommitted_screen.hard_safety: Report wrong selections and coverage without claiming zero-error. Any wrong source on misleading sensor is authentic negative, not a test failure. Show whether true simulator oracle itself outperforms learner; never describe it as deployable.
precommitted_screen.no_hindsight: Do not retune rates, thresholds, guards, source cases, reliability, costs or model after any guard result. Programming bugs may be corrected with exact source/tests preserved and rerun provenance; do not call a fixed bug original first-use.
